Menu
Select Wagyu Course - enjoy the best Wagyu that Yakiniku Rikimaru has to offer
With premium dishes that Yakiniku Rikimaru proudly recommends - such as Today's Wagyu, featuring carefully selected cuts of the day, and the Sirloin Steak, served with a special presentation - you can experience the appeal of Japan's world-renowned Wagyu beef.
Signature Four-Variety Assortment - packed with their top picks
This assortment lets guests enjoy an excellent balance of cuts recommended by the restaurant. Compare a luxurious selection of cuts, each with their unique flavors and textures. A specialty dish that is a must try for guests to this restaurant.
This is a premium all-you-can-eat wagyu beef course featuring a selection of premium wagyu beef dishes.
